values.note: Reserve on ReserveAmerica or the call center (855-622-6727) up to 11 months ahead; county residents up to 12 months in person, and must call the PRT office (864-888-1488) once to set up the resident rate. Waterfront sites require a 2-night minimum; Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day require 3 nights at every site. Maximum 30 days March-October. Check-out noon; gate closed 10 pm-7 am.

values.note: The fee page lists $20 a night for an Oconee County resident ($25 waterfront) and $30 for everyone else ($40 waterfront), with no discounts. The county's reservations page instead says 'Camping rates are $25/night for standard sites and $30/night waterfront sites all taxes included' with residents getting $5 off. $5 parking per car per day.

note: Oconee County park on the shore of Lake Keowee in the Blue Ridge foothills, near Seneca and Clemson. --Claude
